newsitem.title: ITALY: Pope released from hospital after surgery.
newsitem.headline: Pope released from hospital after surgery.

text.p: Pope John Paul was released from hospital on Tuesday, a week after undergoing an operation to remove his appendix.
The 76-year-old Pope left his 10th floor suite at Rome's Gemelli hospital and appeared in the main foyer on his way to a car that was waiting to take him back to the Vatican.

The Pope, wearing a red cape over his white robes, was accompanied to his car by the surgeon who led the operating team, Professor Francesco Crucitti. Onlookers, including many hospital patients, cheered and applauded as he left.
Doctors have told the Polish Pope to rest as much as possible as he continues his convalescence at the Vatican following last Tuesday's surgery.
His next official public appearance is scheduled for Sunday when he is due to read his Sunday prayer and address from the window of his apartments overlooking St Peter's Square.

The Vatican has not excluded the possibility that the Pope will make a brief appearance at the window on Wednesday, when he marks the 18th anniversary of his 1978 election as the first non-Italian Pontiff in 455 years.
